authority_note: Literal synthetic before/intent/after expectations chosen during OSR-35 Refine, independently of command implementation. Historical feature classification follows OSR-60 source audit; exact policies are new acceptance expectations. Codec authority remains contracts/kwdj/v1. No mounted browser/host acceptance is claimed.

conventions.document: Every before/expected document is a full KWDJ v1 prose envelope. Object order is insignificant; expected canonicalization uses existing codec rules. Empty text leaves and empty marks arrays are not authored.
conventions.anchors: Paths are canonical semantic JSON-pointer node paths, not SDK IDs. Text utf16 is a literal UTF-16 code-unit offset; child path names its parent and index its child gap; edge path names its atomic node. A caret denotes identical anchor/focus. Selection explicitly retains direction/affinity. Surviving identity requirements are separate from these semantic paths.
conventions.intents: Semantic strings deliberately do not freeze future command/provider IDs or DTOs. Refusal reason_semantic values are proposed categories, not claims that a stable machine code already exists.
conventions.facts: Historical60 classification means the feature is source-inventoried; every exact golden policy here is synthetic/proposed, not a historical measured command result. New nested/task authoring and Unicode boundary capabilities are explicitly labelled new.
conventions.query_equivalence: Availability predicts the full result for exactly the supplied payload, limits, captured state and identity facts. Query changes no state or allocator high-water; real refusal preserves all committed facets.
conventions.state: Unless explicit, document commands preserve stored-mark override policy from the accepted35 contract. Changed advances document revision once and adds exactly one journal entry; selection epoch changes only when the resulting selection/state facet changes. Refused and dismiss preserve document/selection/epoch/stored marks/revision/journal/maps/dirty. Execution may consume abandoned fresh IDs under34; capability query never may.
conventions.u64: The value18446744073709551615 is an exact JSON integer literal in vector24; do not round it through a JS Number.
conventions.coverage_limit: Illustrative24 vectors are not the complete35 acceptance suite. Stored marks+future typing, query allocator purity, generated invariants, move/duplicate/remove, all limit/refusal variants and native/WASM/mounted proof are still required by their accepted tasks.

vectors.name: paragraph_enter_middle_preserves_layout_and_marks
notes: UTF-16 offset1 is after ASCII a and before the whole emoji. Neither copy loses align/first_line_indent or strong.

vectors.name: empty_paragraph_enter_uses_valid_empty_child_gap
notes: No empty text leaf is persisted; both empty paragraphs are valid semantic nodes.

vectors.name: enter_replaces_selected_range_then_splits_once
notes: Only bc is replaced; prefix a and suffix d survive in separate paragraphs in one document revision.

vectors.name: heading_enter_start_inserts_layout_paragraph_before_heading
notes: Proposed start-boundary policy: inserted empty paragraph precedes the original heading; caret stays at the surviving heading start. Historical60 identifies heading/Enter features, not this measured exact behavior.

vectors.name: heading_enter_end_creates_compatible_layout_paragraph
notes: The new paragraph retains compatible layout; heading-only level is absent there.

vectors.name: empty_heading_enter_becomes_layout_paragraph
notes: Type conversion explicitly removes the source-only heading level and preserves layout.

vectors.name: code_enter_is_literal_newline
notes: Caret UTF-16 moves3→4. No rich hard_break, marks, typography, CR or Unicode normalization is introduced.

vectors.name: shift_enter_inserts_bare_break_and_preserves_styled_fragments
notes: The hard_break wire object has only type. Its after edge is an explicit structural caret, not a fake character offset.

vectors.name: ordered_empty_middle_item_exit_preserves_original_ordinals
notes: Before ordinals are7,8,9; the exited empty8 becomes paragraph and existing C retains9. The trailing list is neither reset to1 nor flattened.

vectors.name: nested_ordered_item_split_moves_all_trailing_descendants
notes: Original ordered start3 stays. tail and checked=true done move intact after b; no descendant flattening, copy-as-text or task metadata reset. This is new nested authoring, not claimed historical60 parity.

vectors.name: nested_empty_item_lift_preserves_inner_tail_and_outer_tail_order
notes: Lift exactly one list level. The old empty inner item becomes the middle outer item. Trailing inner after/nested done and trailing outer Parent tail stay after the lifted caret in the same reading order; Next remains last.

vectors.name: task_item_split_preserves_original_checked_and_initializes_new_item
notes: Existing checked=true and checked=false states are preserved. New task item unchecked is an explicit proposed policy; current60 audit did not establish task authoring.

vectors.name: paragraph_to_heading_preserves_layout_and_ordinary_link
notes: The explicit type/level changes; exact href/title/text/layout and surviving node addressing remain.

vectors.name: reverse_unicode_range_formats_whole_emoji_and_combining_cluster
notes: Input code points are0041 1F600 0065 0301 005A; UTF-16 boundaries0,1,3,4,5,6. Reverse selection5→1 becomes marked-run4→0; no NFC conversion.

vectors.name: complete_grapheme_across_styled_leaves_can_be_formatted_as_one_range
notes: User range endpoints enclose the complete e+U0301 grapheme although the old style boundary is inside it. Original strong on U0301 survives. This vector intentionally prevents a provider from treating each styled leaf end as a required new user range endpoint.

vectors.name: scalar_valid_but_grapheme_interior_format_endpoint_refuses
notes: Range3..4 selects e without its U0301; both are scalar boundaries but end4 is inside the grapheme. Refuse without expansion or text mutation.

vectors.name: ordinary_link_command_cannot_replace_reference_link
notes: The reference stores only its UUID, never the ordinary href/title. A resolved reference is still protected; changing its external slug cannot justify replacement.

vectors.name: slash_accept_preserves_literal_prefix_suffix_atomically
notes: Proposed explicit mid-block insertion policy. Exactly /scene UTF-16[4,10) disappears; the prefix trailing SPACE and suffix leading SPACE stay. One atomic revision/history entry; no prior query-deletion dispatch.

vectors.name: slash_late_journal_refusal_retains_query_prefix_suffix_and_caret
notes: Availability on this actual payload+limit must also refuse. The command is structurally supported; final history capacity is the reason, not a contextual enabled hint.

vectors.name: slash_escape_retains_committed_query_without_dispatch
notes: This is a headless boundary fact for later UI43: dismissing the picker changes no model state and does not erase slash/query text. It is not a mounted keyboard/focus test.

vectors.name: code_shift_enter_is_literal_newline_too
notes: Both code key intentions preserve language, literal text and the one-text-child grammar.

vectors.name: ordered_empty_middle_exit_refuses_exact_u64_numbering_overflow
notes: The admitted start is an exact u64 max; computing a trailing start+2 must refuse without wrapping, floating-point rounding, start reset or partial exit. The exact eventual machine error code remains primary Refine/API work.
